description: Golden reference for metatrain PET model 'pet-attn2', case 'molecule'. Energy in eV, positions in Angstrom, forces in eV/Angstrom. Total energy INCLUDES composition energies and the output scaler.
evaluation_path: metatrain.utils.io.load_model(ckpt).export() -> metatomic AtomisticModel; MetatomicCalculator(model, variants={'energy': 'None'}).compute_energy(atoms, compute_forces_and_stresses=True, per_atom=True)
notes: SYNTHETIC model: pet-mad-xs-v1.6.0 with num_attention_layers raised to 2 and block 0 duplicated into block 1 with a 5%% per-tensor perturbation, via tools/make_multilayer_checkpoint.py. It exists because every published upet model uses num_attention_layers=1, so the multi-block transformer stack has nothing real to validate against -- while metatrain defaults to 2, so a locally trained model can easily need it. The blocks are deliberately NOT identical, so an implementation reading block 0 weights for every block fails this. Reference produced by metatrain itself, as with every other golden.
